answer: Shamir secret sharing splits an identity key into n shares so that any k of them reconstruct it, while fewer reveal nothing at all. The key reaches its zenith only when enough holders wander together to combine their fragments, and each share acts as an anchor holding part of the secret. A Sybil farm cannot fake this at scale because creating a fake identity requires assembling a quorum of genuine shareholders for each forgery, and shareholders cannot be duplicated cheaply across thousands of fake accounts.
